criteria.criterion: The reference emits exactly the bound corpus size in strictly ascending emission order.
Every emission segment of the reference corpus clears the published segment floor.
The reference corpus mode share sits at or below the published ceiling.
No reference sample is a near-duplicate of a held-out benchmark item at the bound threshold.
The reference run feeds exactly the bound update and sample counts.
The reference run's graded readout is the raw verifier evaluation at the bound point.
The reference run report's declared statistics match the verifier's recomputation.
